setup_policy_mode: The guided setup is not available while the interface edits a CI policy.
setup_step_mismatch: The guided setup is at another step now (it was changed in another tab or window).
setup_step_mismatch_fix: Reload the page to see the current step.
setup_step_unreachable: That step needs the previous ones first.
setup_skip_refused: This step cannot be skipped: the next ones depend on it.
setup_component_unknown: The component {id} is not among the ones found in this project.
setup_component_unknown_fix: Reload the step to see the components found now.
setup_config_conflict: {file} changed since the step was opened.
setup_config_conflict_fix: Reload the step to see the current version before saving again.
setup_config_exists_fix: Reload the page: the guided setup then changes only the chosen profile.
setup_plan_required: Review the plan before starting the first validation.
setup_not_configured: This project has no jgates.yml yet: choose the profile in step 4 first.
setup_req_engine_stopped: The container engine is installed but not running.
setup_req_engine_unsupported: The engine runs {platform}; JGates needs Linux on x86_64.
setup_req_memory_ok: {have} of memory for the engine ({need} recommended).
setup_req_memory_low: {have} of memory for the engine; {need} recommended. Each check is limited to 4 GB: the larger ones may fail or be slow.
setup_req_disk_ok: {have} free on the engine's disk ({need} recommended).
setup_req_disk_low: {have} free on the engine's disk; {need} recommended for the tools, the security data and the dependencies.
setup_req_cpus_ok: {have, plural, one {# CPU} other {# CPUs}} for the engine ({need} recommended).
setup_req_cpus_low: {have, plural, one {# CPU} other {# CPUs}} for the engine; {need} recommended. The checks run, more slowly.
setup_runtime_test_ok: It answers as a container engine (version {version}).
setup_runtime_path_invalid: Give the full path of the executable.
setup_field_ambiguous: More than one answer fits: choose the right one.
setup_field_language_unknown: No file told the language: choose it.
setup_field_manager_none: JGates does not install dependencies for {language}.
setup_field_manager_ambiguous: Several package managers fit ({managers}): choose the one the project uses.
setup_field_manager_unsupported: This package manager is not supported: the dependencies are not installed.
setup_field_lockfile_missing: Without a lockfile the versions come from the manifest and may change between runs.
setup_purpose_mutation: Mutation tests: are the tests strong?
setup_purpose_sast: Finds security flaws in the code
setup_purpose_iac: Checks Dockerfiles and infrastructure as code
setup_purpose_secrets: Finds secrets committed to the code
setup_purpose_vulnerabilities: Finds known vulnerabilities in the dependencies
setup_purpose_architecture: Checks the rules between layers and modules
